description: This file contains server-side functions for generating sales funnel reports in an ERP system, including data validation, SQL queries, and data processing for visualizations.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates that the date filters are correct and a company is selected.

methods.name: get_funnel_data
methods.description: Retrieves counts of active leads, opportunities, quotations, and conversions within a date range for a specific company.

methods.name: get_opp_by_lead_source
methods.description: Generates a report of opportunities grouped by lead source and sales stage, including calculated amounts.

methods.name: get_pipeline_data
methods.description: Provides a summarized view of opportunities by sales stage with total amounts.
